Definition: from G1722 and G1349; in the right, i.e. equitable:--just.
BiblicalUsage: Endikos means just — in the right, equitable. Every transgression under the word spoken by angels received a just recompense in Hebrews 2:2, and Paul says the damnation of those who say 'let us do evil that good may come' is just in Romans 3:8.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's justice is exactly just — never too little, never too much — and that is why I can trust His judgments even when I cannot trace them.
